name: Hashikami (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Hashikami town emblem in green and yellow: a green ring with a raised stroke at the upper hoist bearing a yellow device.
history: Municipal flag of Hashikami, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1964.

features.role: Hashikami town emblem — a green ring with a raised stroke at the upper hoist bearing a yellow device
